fact: The Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade plans to launch the TradeTech regulatory sandbox and innovation hub in October 2026, open to startups with an incubator-style environment, per assistant minister Sherif Yehia.

The Ministry of Communication and Information Technology established the Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center, whose mission is to incubate startups in digital technologies, with no programme or cohort stated.
Minister Raafat Hindy says 24 innovation centres have been created, which incubate startups and train young people.
Minister Raafat Hindy says the 24 innovation centres are spread across the governorates.
ICT Minister Raafat Hendy said 24 innovation hubs have been established across different governorates to incubate startups and train young people.
The 24 innovation hubs are spread across different governorates, per Minister Raafat Hendy.
Telecom Egypt's WE Innovate Star programme, run with NTRA and EG-CERT, graduated 20 cybersecurity and AI startups from 83 applicants after over 800 hours of support, per the press release.
Youm7 says the ministry set up 24 Digital Egypt Creativa centres in the governorates to support startups with incubation and training, with partners Plug and Play and 500 Global.
Youm7 says the 24 Digital Egypt Creativa centres are spread across the governorates.

The ICT strategy 2012-2017 plans a national network of 20 technology parks and an entrepreneurship support programme giving innovators space, laboratories and shared services with incubator companies and workshops for emerging companies, and says the Smart Village technology park has attracted investments.
